## About
I'm Jeff Forss, The Alignment Guy. My life in wheel alignment started at a chain shop. After many years of slowly gathering equipment and building a client base, I opened a little shop of my own. These days you'll find me in Hopkins.
I own and use a Hunter alignment computer and have been to several Hunter advanced training workshops. I can also put a vehicle straight with hand tools. I've worked with humble taxis and commuter cars as well as Ferrari and Lotus, and I still take the time to chat and get to know my clients.
My pricing is set similar to the chain shops, yet I don't have the pressure to rush and cut corners that those places put on their workers. As Miracle Max said: "You rush a miracle man, you get rotten miracles."
I work alone, so all work is by appointment. I may growl and bark, but I've never actually bitten anyone. Be on time, don't block the shop door, and stay out of the traffic lanes inside, and you'll get Happy Jeff instead of Crabby Jeff. Thanks for understanding. The shop holds a 4.9 rating from 202 Google reviews.

## Services
- Computerized wheel alignments: Alignments on a Hunter camera system, set to factory specs or your own custom settings.
- Tire service and some sales: Mounting with a Hunter "tulip" style changer with all plastic tool surfaces, and tires bought from Tire Rack, Discount or other mail order sellers are welcome.
- Wheel balancing: Balancing on an FMC/John Bean computer balancer with finger plates for better centering, with a good stock of wheel weight styles on hand.
- Suspension and steering part service: Strut work and bushing and bearing press work, including ball joints, tie rod ends and drive axles.
- Brake reline and rotor/drum machine service: Brake relines and rotor and drum machining; ABS service is not offered at this time.
- Corner weight adjustments: Corner weighting done on Longacre digital scales.
- Motorcycle work: Some motorcycle tire and balancing work using the Hunter machine and a static balancer.
- On-site alignment work: Jeff will consider on-site alignments if it's an interesting job or the price is right.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: Yes. Jeff works alone, so all work is by appointment to keep his day full and your wait shorter. He tends to be booked a few days to a week out, so please call ahead.

Q: What time is the last car in?
A: Usually around 5:00 during the week and 4:00 on Saturday. The shop is closed Sunday.

Q: Can I bring tires I bought online?
A: Yes. Tire Rack, Discount and other mail order buyers are welcome.

Q: Can you align to custom settings?
A: Yes. Jeff can align to factory specs or to custom settings.

Q: Do you do ABS work?
A: Not right now. Jeff doesn't own a scan tool, so he isn't doing ABS service at this time.
